set.body:
From the cold review of S0 (dae45f338, finding F2). After S0, a model-proposed same_situation edge is the only thing joining an off-target record to the target, and the validator trusts it with no timing check: a record at 5-6 s joined to a 10000 s target record by direct_correspondence is Supported (run by the reviewer). Anchors are derived from timing, but the path to them is asserted. The S0 prompt also tells the model which edge earns binding.
Options: a bounded gap or no intervening cut or state change before a same_situation edge can bind, or (preferred) continuity comes only from the recall-blind source graph (S3) and is never a per-question proposal. The S1 expectedFailure test_resists_continuity_across_a_state_change witnesses this.
set.title: [evidence-binding] Continuity edges bind targets without any timing or cut check
